title: A statistical study of giant molecular clouds traced by <SUP>13</SUP>CO, C<SUP>18</SUP>O, CS, and CH<SUB>3</SUB>OH in the disk of NGC 1068 based on ALMA observations
question: What are the physical and chemical properties of GMCs in the disk of NGC 1068, and are they linked to the larger-scale galactic environment?

evidence.quote: the IRAM 30-m measurement gave $13.10 \pm 0.24$ K km s$^{-1}$ ((cite: Aladro2015))
an excitation temperature $T_{\rm ex}$ of 8.5 K ((cite: Nakajima2015))
Adopting an abundance ratio of $[{\rm H}_2]/[^{13}{\rm CO}] = 5.0 \times 10^5$ ((cite: Dickman1978))

recipe.method: CASA clean with Briggs weighting, multiscale, uvcontsub, convolution to 1.4 arcsec
key_parameters: robust 0.4/0.4/0.2/0.1; multiscale [0,10,25]; cell 0.25 arcsec; 1.5 km/s channels

recipe.goal: Check recovered flux against single dish
recipe.method: Convolve 13CO cube to 16" and 21", compare integrated flux with NRO 45-m and IRAM 30-m
CLUMPFIND on 13CO cube; remove clumps smaller than beam
key_parameters: threshold 8σ, increment 4σ; 265 clumps → 187 after excluding diameter < 1.4 arcsec

recipe.goal: Derive LTE gas mass and virial mass
recipe.method: Optically thin LTE column density × clump area; virial mass with beta=1
Fit truncated power law to integral mass distribution for M>1e5 Msun

recipe.goal: Line ratios and methanol vs velocity width
recipe.method: Integrated intensities per GMC, ratios to 13CO, compare linewidths of methanol-detected vs non-detected GMCs with two-sample KS test

answer_key.quantity: GMC mass function slope γ (M≥1e5 Msun)

evidence.quote: The mean and standard deviation are 16.56 km s$^{-1}$ and 5.61 km s$^{-1}$ for methanol-detected GMCs
11.97 km s$^{-1}$ and 4.87 km s$^{-1}$ for methanol-lacking GMCs

answer_key.quantity: Mean GMC size and velocity width

evidence.quote: The averaged size and velocity width of the identified clouds are 102 pc and 14.9 km s$^{-1}$, respectively.

not_stated_but_needed: Clean threshold, masks and iteration count
CLUMPFIND implementation and exact parameters beyond threshold and increment (e.g. velocity handling, pixel-based area)
Fitting method, binning and error estimation for the truncated power law
Calibration/flux-scaling details for datasets and which pipeline version per dataset
Velocity-width definition per cloud and treatment of beam deconvolution
Position of FOV centre (blank in text)
score_reason: ALMA data public, imaging parameters mostly given and catalog tabulated, but CLUMPFIND settings and fit details partly missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data public (project 2013.0.00060.S), recipe largely specified, results numeric (slope, ratios, catalog).
